sentence: A single painted subject splitting into two separate, differently documented objects happens elsewhere in this period too: [Rene Magritte painted The Lovers twice in Paris in 1928, and the two canvases, now held on opposite sides of the world, carry ownership records that look nothing alike](/the-lovers-painting/).

sentence: Unlike William Blake, whose own visionary panel [The Ghost of a Flea](/ghost-of-a-flea/) stayed in private hands, first his friend John Varley's and later a collector's, until it reached the Tate on loan in 1913, Martin's Milton illustrations reached an enormous audience while he was still alive to see it.
